purpose: Evidence-backed exclusions applied before canonical recent-form output is built.

Highwayman.reason: False duplicate of the 2026 Vinnie Roe Stakes. Authoritative public results place the Vinnie Roe Stakes at Leopardstown on 2026-08-20, won by Highwayman; there was no second Vinnie Roe Stakes start seven days later.

Tawny Port.reason: False adjacent-date duplicate of the 2026 Belmont Gold Cup. The race was run at Saratoga on 2026-06-04 local time; 2026-06-05 is the Australian publication/calendar date, not a second start.

Wigmore.reason: False duplicate of the 2026 South Australian Derby. Wigmore won the Group 1 South Australian Derby at Morphettville on 2026-05-02; there was no second South Australian Derby start on 2026-05-09.
